about.subtitle: A little about who I am and how I approach technology.
paragraphs: I'm a Python-focused Software Developer with experience building backend systems, REST APIs, automation utilities, and database-driven applications. I enjoy turning complex problems into clean, reliable, and maintainable software.

My strongest interest is backend engineering with Python, particularly Django, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, automation, and performance optimization. I like going beyond making code simply work — I enjoy understanding how it works, identifying bottlenecks, and finding ways to make systems more efficient and reliable.

I approach engineering with curiosity and a problem-solving mindset: understand the problem first, design the right solution, then build it with attention to performance, scalability, and maintainability. I'm continuously learning and building projects that help me grow into a strong backend engineer.
